case: any case of more than one feeder
cause: phase 4 draws buildings once for the whole case
effect: the same feeder receives other buildings when its case holds other feeders, so a typical feeder run alone and the same feeder inside its substation are different draws; at the pin most of a tested feeder's parquets changed building
handling: stated as a known limitation; typical feeders run alone, and the check set runs whole substations
retest: run one typical feeder alone and inside its substation through phase 4 at the new pin and compare bldg_id per parquet
